entries.en: Hey. Gig's all set up super sweet, like. Tonight, at the Red Dirt.
entries.ro: Hei. Gig-ul e aranjat super beton, gen. În seara asta, la Red Dirt.

entries.en: Talked to Kerry? Didn't change his mind or anything?
entries.ro: Ai vorbit cu Kerry? Nu și-a schimbat părerea sau ceva?

entries.en: Haven't seen him like this since the Silverhand days.
entries.ro: Nu l-am mai văzut așa de pe vremea lui Silverhand.

entries.en: No, no, not at all. He's pretty stoked, in fact.
entries.ro: Nu, nu, deloc. Chiar e tare încântat.

entries.en: Couldn't get Denny to come around?
entries.ro: N-ai reușit să o convingi pe Denny?

entries.en: What about Henry? Still not on board?
entries.ro: Dar Henry? Tot nu e de acord?

entries.en: Nope. Tried my damndest, but no.
entries.ro: Nu. M-am dat peste cap, dar degeaba.

entries.en: And don't worry about your axe. Got the gear all rounded up.
entries.ro: Și nu-ți face griji de chitară. Am adunat tot ce trebuie.

entries.en: Didn't even try. Not wastin' my breath on that dicktip.
entries.ro: Nici n-am încercat. Nu-mi pierd vremea cu jegosul ăla.
